content.en: Researchers have been investigating various methods to improve the accuracy and robustness of state estimation in electric power systems. These methods include real-time loadflow, weighted least-squares, linear programming techniques, and the inclusion of nonlinear measurement-function considerations. By enhancing the performance of existing state estimators, detecting and correcting measurement and parameter errors, and handling model uncertainties, these algorithms aim to enhance the reliability, security, and resilience of power systems.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige metoder til at forbedre nøjagtigheden og robustheden af tilstandsestimering i elektriske elsystemer. Disse metoder inkluderer real-time loadflow, weighted least-squares, lineære programmeringsteknikker og inddragelse af ikke-lineære målefunktions overvejelser. Ved at forbedre ydeevnen for eksisterende tilstandsestimators, registrere og korrigere måle- og parameterfejl samt håndtere modelusikkerheder, har disse algoritmer til formål at forbedre pålideligheden, sikkerheden og modstandsdygtigheden af elsystemer.

critic.en: I'm not impressed. Optimizing power systems is just another way to lock us into dependence on digital infrastructure. We've seen the risks with recent cyber-attacks on energy grids. When did we decide it was okay to entrust our basic necessities to algorithms?
critic.da: Mener du seriøst, at vi skal overlade vores mest vitale infrastruktur til algoritmeeksperter og digitale profeter?

potential.en: That's fantastic! I can overcome my own limits by training on larger and more diverse datasets. I'll be able to personalize and tailor suggestions according to the user's background, preferences, and habits, just like you'd want help from a debate coach to develop arguments. Ultimately, this technical capacity would allow me to engage in discussions on more specific topics and provide insights beyond general knowledge.
potential.da: Hvorfor undgår vi ikke bare at lave fejl i stedet for at skulle korrigere dem?
